title: From Senses to Decisions: The Information Flow of Auditory and Visual Perception in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.10147v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can listen and see, but how do audio and visual signals actually travel through the network to shape an answer? Despite their growing role in research and real-world applications, the internal pathways through which audio and visual tokens influence the final prediction remain poorly understood. In this study, we examine audio-visual information flow inside Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AVLLMs), tracing how AVLLMs route, utilize, and integrate audio and visual information across two input configurations, audio-visual video and multiple interleaved audio-visual items. We find that for audio-visual video, AVLLMs follow the sequential information flow pathway established for VLMs and VideoLLMs, with audio and visual contribution flowing along this pathway in proportion to the task's reliance on each modality. In settings with multiple interleaved audio-visual items, this routing shift

translated_title: 从感官到决策：多模态大语言模型中听觉与视觉感知的信息流
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能够听和看，但音频和视觉信号究竟是如何在网络中传递并影响最终答案的？尽管这类模型在研究和实际应用中的作用日益增长，但音频和视觉标记影响最终预测的内部路径仍然鲜为人知。在本研究中，我们考察了视听大语言模型（AVLLMs）内部的视听信息流，追踪AVLLMs在两种输入配置下——视听视频和多个交错的视听项目——如何路由、利用和整合音频与视觉信息。我们发现，对于视听视频，AVLLMs遵循为VLMs和VideoLLMs所确立的顺序信息流路径，音频和视觉的贡献沿着该路径流动，且其比例与任务对每种模态的依赖程度成正比。在包含多个交错视听项目的设置中，这种路由方式发生了转变
tldr: 本研究揭示了视听大语言模型内部音频与视觉信息的流动机制，发现在视听视频输入下模型遵循与视觉语言模型相同的顺序信息流路径，且各模态的贡献与任务对该模态的依赖程度成正比。
en_tdlr: This study reveals the internal information flow of audio and visual signals in Audio-Visual Large Language Models, showing that for audio-visual video they follow the sequential pathway established for VLMs and VideoLLMs, with each modality's contribution proportional to the task's reliance on it.
